title: Open WebUI gets better starting points
summary:
Eleven community apps joined the catalog while Open WebUI, model routing, payment flows, and agent tools got attention.

Open WebUI added four pinned everyday models for people without their own pins, switched new chats to `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, and added general-purpose starter prompts. Its production container also gained capacity. Elsewhere, Play stopped sending reference images to models that cannot use them, while the dashboard clarified price labels and request estimates. Quests received a layout adjustment, and the website stopped retrying non-rate-limit errors.

Community builders added eleven apps: voice murder mysteries, real-or-AI guessing games, three pass-and-play deduction games, and Postcard Worlds, which uses generated images and vision to make explorable scenes. Tunemory and Chorus also turn study notes into songs. Apparently the next sensible use for AI is accusing your friends of being impostors.

A new x402 endpoint lets buyers choose a prepaid API key amount from $0.01 to $10,000 without a Pollinations login; existing pack URLs still work. Browser visits to legacy image and text paywalls now get a readable payment page with a Weft setup link, while agents keep their JSON response. Key editing also stopped extending an unchanged expiry through rounding.

daily.title: Open WebUI chat starters
daily.text: New chats start with `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, and people without custom pins get four everyday models in the picker. Four general-purpose prompts offer a place to start.

daily.title: Direct Claude Code harness
daily.text: Use `polli harness claude-code on` to configure Claude Code for Gen’s `/v1/messages` endpoint without Claude Code Router. Pollinations settings stay separate from your native Claude login and settings. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).
